program.address_context: Original unrelocated file-backed EE PT_LOAD; named M2 project copied from preserved M1 working project.

provenance.source: Fresh read-only, no-analysis HGExport snapshots of the existing M2 Ghidra project for M11; verified against the original Japanese ELF.
limitations: 0015ebc0 reconstructed except the unobserved special-surface (0x1e00) branch, which fails closed.
Remaining functions are instruction evidence for modeled leaves, not reconstructions.

functions.name: hg_player_static_constraint
functions.interpretation: Reconstructed in C: four probe tiers, query-result filtering, VU0 facing test, push application and probe restart, result flags, bump timer and sound selection. Hits flagged 0x1e00 (special surfaces, 0015eaf0 path) fail closed.

functions.name: scene_segment_query
functions.interpretation: Modeled original instructions, not reconstructed: combines static-geometry 00145740 and 00267ed0 results and their 3f39a0 hit record.

functions.name: static_geometry_query
functions.interpretation: Modeled, not reconstructed. For a triangle hit, 145b10..145b1c copies an unwritten fourth-vertex stack quad into 3f3a00; the M11 host guest-frame contract preserves it.

functions.name: random_next
functions.interpretation: Modeled RNG wrapper used by the observed bump branch.

functions.name: interrupt_disable
functions.interpretation: Modeled DI helper reached by the sound request; CP0 Status is a supplied, varied input.
